name: Begum Hazrat Mahal
role: Regent who led resistance in Awadh
contribution: Begum Hazrat Mahal, regent for her young son Birjis Qadr, led resistance to British rule in Awadh during the 1857 rebellion and helped organize the defense of Lucknow.
context: She opposed the annexation of Awadh and worked with regional commanders and other rebel leaders. After British forces recaptured Lucknow, she retreated to Nepal rather than accept the restoration of Company authority.
impact: Hazrat Mahal is remembered as one of the most prominent women leaders of 1857. Her career shows how dynastic claims, anti-annexation politics, and military resistance converged in Awadh.
highlight: Awadh regent who led resistance to British rule during the 1857 rebellion.
seoTitle: Begum Hazrat Mahal: Leader of Awadh's 1857 Resistance
seoDescription: Learn about Begum Hazrat Mahal, the Awadh regent who led resistance against British rule during the Indian Rebellion of 1857.
shortAnswer: Begum Hazrat Mahal was the regent of Awadh who led resistance against British rule during the 1857 rebellion.

faq.question: Who was Begum Hazrat Mahal?
faq.answer: She was the regent of Awadh who led resistance against British rule and helped organize the rebel defense of Lucknow during 1857.
